top_signals.title: Stocks Fall on Tech Disruptions as Nvidia in Focus: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A selloff in technology giants dragged down stocks on mounting concerns about technical disruptions, with investors also looking to Nvidia Corp.’s earnings for a read on the outlook for artificial intelligence.

top_signals.title: Curtin Harbor Services Appoints Ralph Franjul as General Manager
top_signals.summary: Ralph Franjul has been appointed as the General Manager of Curtin Harbor Services (CHS). As a newly formed zero-emission harbor towage company, CHS is building a fleet of eight battery-electric tugs to serve the California market at the Snow & Company shipyard in Seattle, Washington.
